title: Baked Oatmeal with Apples and Walnuts
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F (175C). Grease an 8-inch square baking dish.
In a large bowl, combine oats, baking powder, and cinnamon.
In a separate bowl, combine coconut oil, almond milk, and maple syrup.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and stir to combine.
Spread the oat mixture in greased baking dish.
Top with apples and walnuts.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Spinach and Cheese Frittata
description: A protein-rich egg-based dish, perfect for breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F (175C).
Over medium heat, warm up the olive oil in a sizable oven-safe pan.
Add spinach and onion and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a medium bowl, combine eggs, Parmesan cheese, feta cheese, salt, and pepper.
Pour egg mixture into skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Place skillet in preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Baked Sweet Potato Fries
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 4 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into fries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F (200C).
Place sweet potatoes on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with garlic powder, paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Toss to coat.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.

title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 2 pounds Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F (200C).
Place Brussels sprouts on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Toss to coat.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.

title: Grilled Salmon
description: A light and healthy seafood dish, rich in omega-3s.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Brush salmon fillets with olive oil and season with garlic powder, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Place salmon on preheated grill and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until the desired doneness.
Serve.

title: Quinoa Pilaf
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Over medium heat, warm up the olive oil in a sizable oven-safe pan.
Add onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add quinoa, peas, bell pepper, and parsley and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper, to taste.
Serve.

title: Roasted Vegetable Salad
description: A fresh and healthy salad option, great for any meal.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F (200C).
Place vegetables on a baking sheet.
Add some olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Roast vegetables for 20 minutes or until soft.
Transfer to a large bowl and add feta cheese, parsley, and balsamic vinegar.
Toss to combine.
Serve.

title: Baked Fish Sticks
description: A light and healthy seafood dish, rich in omega-3s.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F (200C).
Cut fish fillets into 1-inch strips.
In a shallow dish, combine breadcrumbs, Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Dip fish strips in breadcrumb mixture, pressing to coat.
Place fish strips on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until thoroughly done and golden brown.

title: Lentil Soup
description: A warm and hearty dish, ideal for cozy meals.
instructions: In a big saucepan, warm up the olive oil over medium heat.
Cook carrot, celery, onion, and garlic for 5 minutes, stirring periodically.
Add lentils, broth, and oregano and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, to taste.
Serve.

title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Over medium heat, warm olive oil in a large skillet.
Add garlic, bell pepper, and mushrooms; cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add peas and rice; cook 5 minutes more, stirring occasionally.
Stir in soy sauce and sesame seeds.
Cook another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve.

title: Baked Sweet Potato Chips
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 2 large sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced into rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F (200C).
Place sweet potato slices on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Toss to coat evenly.
Bake 15 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Serve.

title: Veggie Burgers
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Cook onion and garlic for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Combine quinoa, black beans, oats, parsley, flaxseed, paprika, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Form mixture into 6 patties.
Cook patties in skillet for 5 minutes per side, until golden brown.
Serve.

title: Baked Parmesan Zucchini
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F (200C).
Arrange zucchini slices on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Toss to coat evenly.
Bake for 20 minutes until crispy and golden brown.
Serve.

title: Roasted Cauliflower
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F (200C).
Place cauliflower florets on baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Toss to coat.
Bake for 25 minutes until tender and golden brown.
Serve.

title: Quinoa Salad
description: A fresh and healthy salad option, great for any meal.
instructions: Combine quinoa, bell pepper, corn, and parsley in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil and vinegar in a small bowl.
Pour dressing over quinoa mixture; toss well.
Season with salt and pepper, to taste.
Serve.

title: Baked Tofu
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 1 block firm tofu, cut into cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F (200C).
Arrange tofu cubes on baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Toss to coat evenly.
Bake for 25 minutes until crispy and golden brown.
Serve.

title: Spicy Roasted Chickpeas
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F (200C).
Place chickpeas on baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, chili powder, garlic powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Toss to coat evenly.
Bake for 25 minutes until crispy and golden.
Serve.

title: Baked Falafel
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F (200C).
Combine chickpeas, onion, parsley, garlic, tahini, cumin, salt, and pepper in a food processor; pulse until chunky.
Form mixture into 12 patties and place on baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil.
Bake 20 minutes until crispy and golden brown.
Serve.

title: Baked Eggplant
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F (200C).
Arrange eggplant slices on baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Toss to coat evenly.
Bake 20 minutes until tender and golden brown.
Serve.

title: Kale and Sweet Potato Hash
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 1 large sweet potato, peeled and diced
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Cook sweet potato, onion, and garlic for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add kale; cook additional 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve.

title: Classic Breakfast Porridge
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Place oats, cinnamon, and water in a saucepan. Heat over low heat, stir for 5–7 minutes.
Simmer for 5 more minutes.
Remove from heat.
Spoon into bowls and serve with milk and fruit. Garnish with cinnamon.

title: Early Morning Frittata
description: A protein-rich egg-based dish, perfect for breakfast or brunch.
ingredients: 7 oz new potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Sauté leeks, onions, and potatoes in oil for 5 minutes.
Add zucchini, then eggs and ricotta. Stir to combine.
Cook 10–15 minutes until eggs set.
Lower heat and cook 10 more minutes until fluffy.
Serve flipped onto a plate.

title: Tasty Bircher Muesli
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Combine milk, orange juice, water, almond meal, cinnamon, sesame seeds, oats, and orange rind in a bowl.
Cover and refrigerate for 6–8 hours.
Stir before serving.
Top with blueberries and enjoy.

title: Delicious Baked Eggs with Tomato and Spinach
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and grease ramekins with cooking spray.
Sauté tomatoes and mushrooms until browned.
Add spinach and toss for 1–2 minutes.
Spoon mixture into ramekins.
Crack eggs over the top and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for 15 minutes or until eggs are set.
Serve with toast.

title: Early Morning Breakfast Cups
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Whisk eggs and pour into muffin cups.
Distribute chopped asparagus evenly.
Sprinkle cheese over the top.
Bake for 10–12 minutes or until eggs are fully cooked and fluffy.
Serve immediately.

title: Classic Breakfast Porridge
description: A warm and hearty breakfast to keep you satisfied during pregnancy.
instructions: Place oats, cinnamon, and water into a small saucepan.
Heat over low heat, stirring for 5–7 minutes.
Simmer for another 5 minutes with remaining water.
Remove from heat.
Spoon into bowls, add milk, top with fruit, and enjoy.

title: Early Morning Frittata
description: A filling and nutritious breakfast great for groups.
ingredients: 7 ounces new potatoes, peeled and sliced into rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Heat oil in a skillet, cook leek, onion, and potatoes until soft (~5 min).
Add zucchini, stir to combine.
Add eggs and ricotta, mix well.
Cook on medium for 10–15 minutes until eggs are cooked.
Lower heat and cook another 10 min to fluff.
Flip onto plate and serve.

title: Tasty Bircher Muesli
description: A chilled, blood sugar-friendly breakfast option.
instructions: Combine oats, milk, juice, water, almond meal, cinnamon, sesame seeds, and rind in a bowl.
Cover and refrigerate for 6–8 hours.
Stir and top with blueberries before serving.

title: Delicious Baked Eggs with Tomato and Spinach
description: A classy, protein-rich baked breakfast.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and grease ramekins.
Sauté tomatoes and mushrooms until browned.
Add spinach and cook 1–2 minutes.
Divide mixture into ramekins, crack an egg on top, sprinkle cheese.
Bake 15 minutes or until eggs are set.
Serve with toast.

title: Early Morning Breakfast Cups
description: Portable and protein-rich breakfast muffin cups.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Whisk eggs and divide into muffin pan cups.
Distribute asparagus and sprinkle cheese.
Bake 10–12 minutes until fluffy and cooked.
Serve warm.

title: Classic French Toast
description: A low-fat twist on a breakfast classic.
instructions: Place milk and whisked eggs in separate bowls.
Heat pan with spray over medium-high heat.
Dip bread into milk then egg, and fry until golden (~2–3 min per side).
Serve with ricotta, strawberries, and cinnamon.

title: Hearty Bacon, Lettuce, Tomato and Egg Sandwich
description: A satisfying breakfast or lunch protein sandwich.
instructions: Grill bacon and drain.
Fry eggs and toast bread simultaneously.
Assemble sandwich with bacon, eggs, tomatoes, lettuce, and chili sauce.
Serve with pickles if desired.

title: Creamy Potato Salad
description: A picnic-ready potato salad with healthy swaps.
ingredients: 1 large cucumber, chopped into small pieces
instructions: Boil potatoes for 10 minutes until firm, drain and cool.
Combine potatoes, cucumber, yogurt, mustard, and seasoning in a bowl.
Toss thoroughly and serve.

title: Sri Lanka Style Spicy Fish
description: A bold, exotic fish dish served with couscous.
instructions: Brush fish with oil and rub with spice mix.
Cook couscous per package instructions.
Bring stock and oil to boil, then remove from heat and stand 5 min.
Fluff couscous and mix in parsley, capsicum, almonds.
Blanch broccoli.
Cook fish on skillet 5–10 min each side until flaky.
Serve fish on couscous with broccoli and lemon wedges.

title: Tasty Fennel and Almond Salad
description: A sweet, crunchy fennel salad with a zesty dressing.
instructions: Mix lemon juice, oil, dill, and currants in a bowl.
Add fennel and toss to coat.
Serve over arugula leaves and top with almonds.
Season with black pepper and serve.

title: Tasty Grilled Salmon
description: A flexible seafood recipe that pairs beautifully with veggies or fruits.
ingredients: 7 oz carrots, peeled and cut into small sticks
instructions: Make gremolata: blend parsley, lemon zest and juice, garlic, olive oil, and chili.
Lightly grease a skillet and heat to medium-high.
Season salmon with salt and pepper, cook for 4 minutes per side until crispy.
Cook carrots and risoni as per instructions.
Serve salmon over spinach and risoni, topped with gremolata and carrots.

title: Cumin Spiced Carrots
description: A quick and exotic carrot side dish, full of flavor and warmth.
instructions: Boil carrots until tender, then drain.
Return carrots to pan, add oil, parsley, and lemon juice.
Toss well and serve warm.

title: Delicious Fish Kebabs and Potato Salad
description: A flavorful grilled kebab dish paired with creamy potato salad.
ingredients: 1/2 pound firm white fish fillets, cubed
instructions: Thread fish onto skewers, place in shallow bowl.
Mix oil, lemon rind and juice, oregano, garlic, cinnamon, and pepper into marinade. Pour over kebabs and marinate 1 hour.
Boil potatoes 10 min until firm, drain and cool.
Mix potatoes with cucumber, yogurt, and mustard.
Grill fish skewers for ~6 minutes.
Serve kebabs with potato salad.

title: Japanese Style Coleslaw
description: A crisp and flavorful Asian-inspired coleslaw.
instructions: Combine cabbage, daikon, carrot, shallots, coriander, and sesame seeds in a bowl.
Whisk dressing ingredients in another bowl and thin with water.
Pour dressing over salad, toss well.
Season with pepper and serve immediately.

title: Nicoise Style Salad
description: A hearty salad loaded with vegetables, protein, and flavor.
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender, adding green beans during final 2 minutes.
Drain and rinse with water.
Quarter potatoes and combine with beans, tomatoes, olives, capers, tuna, and mushrooms.
Whisk oil, vinegar, and anchovies for dressing.
Top salad with dressing and egg quarters.

title: Roasted Cauliflower with Lemon and Olives
description: A low-carb, flavor-packed veggie dish with bold Mediterranean notes.
ingredients: 1/2 cup black olives, roasted and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Coat cauliflower with paprika and spray. Roast 25 min, turning once.
Toss cauliflower with lemon, olives, capsicum, lemon juice, oil, and parsley.
Serve immediately.

title: Healthy Poached Chicken Salad
description: A protein-rich and refreshing salad perfect for lunch.
ingredients: 1 13 oz can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Bring chicken stock to a boil, reduce to low, and poach chicken for 15 min.
Shred chicken with forks and set aside.
Blanch green beans 2–3 minutes, rinse with cold water.
Make dressing with lemon juice, mustard, garlic, mint, and oil.
Toss chicken, beans, greens, and dressing together.
Garnish with parsley and serve.

title: Saffron Style Couscous Salad
description: A bright, aromatic couscous salad that pairs well with tuna or grilled meats.
ingredients: 1/4 tsp saffron threads soaked in water
instructions: Sauté onion in olive oil until translucent (~8–10 min).
Add tomato paste, cumin, coriander, and cinnamon. Cook until fragrant (~3 min).
Add saffron water and couscous, mix thoroughly.
Stir in capsicum, tomatoes, olives, parsley, orange juice, and lemon zest.
Serve warm or chilled.

title: Peach Style Chicken Salad
description: A summery sweet-and-savory chicken salad perfect for hot days.
instructions: Boil potatoes 10 minutes, drain and set aside.
Cook chicken in sprayed pan until golden (~5–10 min).
Add balsamic vinegar and caramelize.
Remove chicken and rest 5 min before slicing.
Stir yogurt, shallots, orange juice, and zest together for dressing.
Toss tomatoes, cucumber, peaches, mint, and potatoes with dressing.
Add salad greens and top with chicken slices.

title: Tarragon Style Roasted Fish
description: A herbed baked fish recipe with hearty sides.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Sauté leeks and garlic in oil until soft (~10 min). Reserve half.
Add lemon juice/rind and season the mixture.
Stuff fish with leek mix and lemon rounds. Wrap in parchment.
Roast fish for 25 min.
Roast sweet potatoes separately until soft.
Combine lentils with reserved leek mixture and season.
Serve fish with sweet potato and lentil mix.

title: Lemon and Thyme Roasted Chicken
description: A classic roast chicken infused with lemon and thyme, perfect for a hearty dinner.
ingredients: 4 ½ pounds whole free-range chicken, rinsed and dried
½ head garlic, unpeeled and separated
1 ¾ pounds potatoes, peeled and quartered
Green vegetables of your choice, for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Pat chicken dry and place in a large baking dish.
Stuff cavity with thyme and tie legs together.
Spray chicken with cooking spray, season with salt and pepper.
Surround with lemon, garlic, carrots, and potatoes. Spray again.
Bake for 1½ hours or until cooked through.
Let rest for 5 minutes, serve with green vegetables.

title: Savory Curried Chicken with Beans and Currants
description: A rich, comforting curry balanced with sweet currants and green beans.
ingredients: 1½ pounds chicken breasts, trimmed and cut into strips
½ cup coconut essence or milk
13 oz green beans, trimmed and cooked
instructions: Spray skillet and sauté onion until translucent.
Add chicken and garlic, cook until golden (~10–15 min).
Stir in curry powder until fragrant.
Reduce heat, add milk, coconut, and currants.
Simmer for 5 min, add green beans, simmer another 5–10 min.
Serve over rice, garnish with coriander and cucumber.

title: San Choy Bau
description: A flavorful Asian-inspired lettuce wrap packed with protein and crunch.
ingredients: ½ oz fresh ginger, finely grated
1 red chili, seeded and finely chopped
1 oz vermicelli noodles, cooked and chopped
instructions: Heat sesame and cooking oil in a wok over medium heat.
Add pork and cook until browned.
Add ginger, garlic, mushrooms, chili, chestnuts, carrot, zucchini, and onion.
Add spring onions and noodles, stir thoroughly.
Stir in lime juice, vinegar, and tamari. Remove from heat.
Top with sesame seeds and serve in lettuce leaves.

title: Pesto Smothered Pasta with Chicken
description: Creamy, herb-loaded pesto pasta paired with protein-rich chicken and veggies.
instructions: Blend pesto ingredients until smooth, set aside.
Cook pasta, toss with pesto, and cover.
Blanch green beans as desired.
Season chicken with salt and pepper, cook in skillet ~5–8 min per side.
Add tomatoes and cook additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot with pasta and veggies.

title: Savory Chicken Burritos
description: A build-your-own burrito recipe full of fresh, flavorful fillings.
ingredients: 1 pound chicken breast, cut into strips
1 head baby lettuce, washed and torn
instructions: Toss chicken with spice in a ziplock bag.
Cook chicken in skillet until golden (~5–8 min).
Lay out all ingredients on serving plate.
Assemble burritos as desired with toppings.
Serve with lime wedges and enjoy.

title: Coconut Almond Cookies
description: Tasty almond and cheese cookies with coconut flakes. Great for snacking and storage.
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix almond butter and egg yolks until smooth.
Add grated cheese and mix until incorporated.
Stir in almond flour to form a dough.
Add coconut flakes and mix until just combined.
Shape into small balls, flatten into coins.
Bake for about 20 minutes until lightly golden.
Cool on rack and store in a jar.

title: Simple Roasted Squash
description: Roasted butternut squash tossed in almond butter and olive oil. Great for skin and baby brain development.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and line baking sheet.
Microwave almond butter and combine with olive oil and cumin.
Peel and wedge the squash, toss in mixture.
Roast for 30 minutes until tender.
Serve and enjoy.

title: Unsweetened Roasted Cashew
description: Simple roasted cashew snack with olive oil drizzle. High in protein and fats.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and line baking sheet.
Spread cashews and bake for 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.
Drizzle with olive oil and toss.
Cool and enjoy.

title: The Berries Muffin
description: Low-sugar muffins with blueberries and cranberries, rich in potassium.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and prepare muffin cups.
Mix almond flour, zest, cinnamon.
Beat eggs, combine with oil and yogurt.
Combine wet and dry ingredients, fold in berries.
Divide into cups and bake 20 minutes.
Cool and serve.

title: Almond Egg Tart
description: Low-sugar tart with a soft, creamy filling. Can be enhanced with meat or vegetables.
instructions: Beat butter and yolk, add almond flour to form dough.
Preheat oven to 350°F, grease 10 pie pans.
Divide dough and press into pans.
Bake 10 minutes until lightly golden.
Beat eggs and almond milk.
Fill pies and bake 10–15 minutes until set.
Cool and serve.

title: Coconut Squares
description: Energy-rich snack using coconut flakes and butter. Low in sugar, great for morning sickness.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F, line baking sheet.
Melt butter and mix with eggs.
Stir in shredded coconut.
Spread on sheet and bake 10 minutes.
Cool, cut into squares and serve.

title: Coconut Chicken Crispy
description: Low-carb crispy chicken with coconut crust. Fish is a good substitute.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F, line baking pan.
Beat eggs with pepper.
Dip chicken slices in egg, flour, egg, then coconut flakes.
Bake 20 minutes until brown and crispy.
Serve hot.

title: Avocado and Strawberry Salads
description: Refreshing salad rich in folic acid and water content. Supports fetal development.
instructions: Cut avocado and strawberries, combine in bowl.
Add lettuce and drizzle dressing.
Toss well and serve fresh.

title: Meaty Tofu Bars
description: Tofu-based protein snack with ground beef. Rich in amino acids and great for preeclampsia prevention.
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Steam in a greased pan for 20 minutes.
Cool, slice into bars.
Bake at 350°F for 5 minutes to brown.
Serve warm.

title: Cheesy Spinach Balls
description: Nutrient-rich snack using spinach, eggs, and cheese. Good for iron and folic acid.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F, line baking sheet.
Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Shape into balls, bake for 15 minutes.
Serve warm.

title: Spinach Mushroom Quiche
description: A nutritious quiche combining spinach, mushrooms, and cheese. Great for both mom and baby.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a pie pan.
Sauté onion in olive oil, add spinach and mushroom, cook until wilted.
Beat eggs, add cheese and pepper.
Mix in sautéed vegetables and pour into pie pan.
Bake 30 minutes until set.
Cool slightly, slice, and serve.

title: Almond Berry Porridge
description: A filling, nutritious almond porridge topped with berries. Ideal for starting your day.
ingredients: ¼ cup mixed strawberries and blueberries
instructions: Simmer almond flour and flax seeds in water until thickened.
Stir in beaten egg and cook briefly.
Mix in almond butter.
Top with berries and serve.

title: Baked Sweet Potato
description: Simple roasted sweet potato with butter. Rich in beta-carotene and fiber.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and prick potatoes with a fork.
Bake for 50 minutes.
Split and top with butter.
Serve warm.

title: Cheesy Omelet with Tomato
description: Quick, protein-packed omelet with mozzarella and tomato. Great for busy mornings.
instructions: Beat eggs with pepper.
Cook omelet in olive oil.
Transfer to oven-safe pan, top with cheese.
Bake briefly, then top with tomato and serve.

title: Cheesy Vegetable Frittata
description: A veggie-packed frittata with spinach, broccoli, and cheese. Perfect family breakfast.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Sauté onion and garlic, add spinach and broccoli, cook till wilted.
Whisk eggs, egg whites, water, pepper.
Combine with veggies, pour into pan, top with cheese.
Bake 10 minutes until set. Cool and slice to serve.

title: Easy Coconut Granola
description: Homemade crunchy granola with nuts and coconut. Great with plant-based milk.
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F, line baking sheet.
Mix all dry ingredients, drizzle with oil and cinnamon.
Spread on sheet and bake 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Store in jar and serve with almond or coconut milk.

title: Quinoa and Peach Porridge
description: Fiber-rich and magnesium-packed quinoa porridge. Sweetened naturally with peaches.
instructions: Toast quinoa and cinnamon in saucepan.
Add milk and water, bring to boil then simmer until thick.
Serve warm.

title: Soft Almond Pancakes
description: Gluten-free pancakes made from almond flour and yogurt. Great for gestational diabetes.
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Cook in oiled pan over medium heat until golden.
Serve warm.

title: Healthy and Meaty Sweet Potato Casserole
description: Nutritious baked casserole with sweet potato, ground beef, and vegetables.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease baking dish.
Layer sweet potato, broccoli, onion, beef.
Whisk eggs with mustard, garlic, coconut milk.
Pour over layers and top with cheese.
Cover and bake for 45 minutes until set.

title: Simple Baked Beans
description: Fiber and protein-rich baked beans. Easy to pair with toast or waffles.
ingredients: ¾ tbsp. low sodium soy sauce
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in oil until aromatic.
Add beans, soy sauce, mustard.
Transfer to greased baking dish and bake at 350°F for 20 minutes.
Serve warm.

title: Pulled Pork
description: Tender shredded pork seasoned with herbs. Great with whole grain bread or salads.
ingredients: ¾ cup low sodium chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F and prepare baking dish.
Combine spices and rub over pork.
Bake pork uncovered for 1 hour.
Reduce heat to 350°F, add broth, cover and bake for 2 more hours.
Let cool, shred with forks, and serve.

title: Chicken Cucumber Salads
description: Refreshing salad with protein-packed chicken and hydrating cucumber.
ingredients: ¾ tsp. low sodium soy sauce
instructions: Make dressing by mixing peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic.
Cube cucumber, discard seeds.
Combine cucumber and chicken in bowl, drizzle dressing, toss and serve.

title: Roasted Mixed Vegetables
description: A colorful mix of roasted veggies with herbs and balsamic glaze. Great as a side or main.
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°F and coat baking dish.
Add all vegetables and herbs, drizzle oil and vinegar, toss to combine.
Roast for 45 minutes until tender.
Serve warm.

title: Chicken Tomato Taco
description: Protein-rich taco with fresh tomato filling and whole grain wrap.
instructions: Sauté garlic in olive oil, then add chicken and pepper. Stir well.
Place tortilla on surface, add chicken and tomato, fold and serve.
Optionally bake tortilla or garnish with celery.

title: Mushroom Beef Stew
description: Slow-cooked beef and mushroom stew with peas and carrot. Hearty and iron-rich.
instructions: Place beef, carrot, peas, onion, mushroom, broth, and thyme in slow cooker.
Cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4 hours.
Stir in peas before serving.

title: Delicious Pork Loaf
description: Hearty protein-rich pork meatloaf, great for meal prep or on-the-go lunches.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and prepare baking sheet.
Blend all ingredients in food processor.
Form log, wrap in foil, bake 1 hour.
Cool slightly, unwrap, slice and serve.

title: Spicy Beef Lettuce Wraps
description: Spiced beef with green beans wrapped in crisp lettuce. Portable and low-carb.
ingredients: ½ cup low sodium beef broth
instructions: Sauté garlic and onion in oil, add sliced beef and cook.
Add broth, green beans, and spices, simmer.
Serve beef in lettuce wraps.

title: Savory Shrimps Soup
description: Light and flavorful shrimp soup with coconut milk and carrots.
instructions: Boil carrot in water.
Add garlic, shallot, spices, lemon juice.
Add shrimp and coconut milk, simmer until pink.
Serve warm.

title: Healthy Chicken Broccoli
description: Quick sautéed chicken and broccoli dish with garlic and soy sauce.
instructions: Sauté garlic in oil, add chicken and cook with water.
Add broccoli and leek, drizzle soy sauce.
Cook until vegetables wilt, serve warm.

title: Baked Pork Fritter
description: Oven-baked spiced pork fritters. Convenient for lunch on the go.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and line baking sheet.
Blend ingredients in food processor.
Shape into fritters, bake 15 minutes until golden.
Serve warm.

title: Steamed Fish with Green Chili
description: Steamed fresh fish with bold chili and herb flavors. Light and oil-free.
instructions: Preheat steamer and prepare heatproof dish.
Blend garlic, shallots, and chili into a paste.
Rub fish with paste, place in dish with galangal and bay leaf.
Steam for 30 minutes and serve warm.

title: Buttery Beef Steak
description: Quick grilled sirloin steak with almond garlic butter. Rich and satisfying.
instructions: Melt almond butter with garlic in a saucepan.
Season steak with pepper, grill to desired doneness (5–9 mins).
Drizzle butter over steak and serve warm.

title: Pork Satay in Tomato Sauce
description: Tender pork satay with a tangy tomato-based sauce. Grilled and simmered.
ingredients: ½ cup low sodium beef broth
instructions: Boil pork with garlic, coriander, bay leaf, and lime leaves until tender.
Cool, skewer and grill until lightly browned.
Sauté onion, add tomato puree, spices, and broth. Simmer into sauce.
Serve skewers topped with sauce.

title: Mixed Cauliflower Curry
description: Colorful vegetable curry with cauliflower, peas, and carrots in spiced broth.
instructions: Sauté garlic and onion in oil. Add all vegetables and spices.
Pour in water, bring to boil and simmer until veggies are tender.
Serve warm.

title: Simple Kale Garlic
description: Simple sautéed kale with garlic. High in iron, fiber, and vitamin C.
instructions: Sauté kale and garlic in olive oil until wilted.
Add water, bring to boil and simmer until kale is tender.
Serve warm.

title: Roasted Chicken with Potato and Tomato
description: Whole chicken roasted with potatoes and tomatoes in thyme seasoning.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line baking dish.
Toss potatoes and tomatoes in oil, thyme, and pepper, layer in dish.
Place chicken on top, drizzle more oil mixture.
Roast for 45 minutes, then serve warm.

title: Boiled Eggs in Red Thick Gravy
description: Hard-boiled eggs simmered in spicy coconut tomato gravy with herbs.
instructions: Sauté garlic and shallots in oil, add chili, bay leaf, galangal.
Add water and boiled eggs. Bring to boil.
Stir in tomato puree and coconut milk. Simmer 5 mins.
Serve warm.

title: Savory Shrimps Veggie
description: Shrimp stir-fry with broccoli and carrots in tomato-based sauce.
ingredients: ¼ cup low sodium chicken broth
instructions: Sauté onion in oil. Add shrimp and cook until pink.
Add broccoli and carrot, then seasonings and broth.
Simmer until vegetables are crisp-tender. Serve warm.

title: Baked Salmon Black Pepper
description: Oven-baked salmon fillets seasoned with black pepper and sesame.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and line baking sheet.
Brush salmon with oil, sprinkle pepper. Bake 15 mins.
Flip, brush again and sprinkle sesame. Bake 15 more mins.
Serve warm.

title: Pumpkin Soup
description: Creamy and nutritious pumpkin soup blended with coconut and spice.
instructions: Sauté onion, carrot, and celery in oil.
Add broth, pumpkin, cinnamon, and pepper. Simmer.
Blend until smooth and serve warm.

title: Delicious Fish Kebabs and Potato Salad
description: A filling and delicious dish perfect for gestational diabetes. Marinate for best flavor.
ingredients: 1 ½ lb fish fillet, white and firm, finely chopped
¼ cup fresh oregano, coarsely chopped
instructions: Thread fish chunks onto skewers and place in a shallow ceramic bowl.
Combine oil, lemon rind and juice, oregano, cinnamon, and garlic in a jar. Add salt and pepper. Shake to combine.
Pour marinade over kebabs and toss well. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Boil potatoes until firm. Drain and let cool.
Toss potatoes with cucumber, yogurt, and mustard.
Preheat grill to high. Grill kebabs for 6 minutes.
Serve kebabs with potato salad.

title: Savory Chicken Burritos
description: Easy, customizable burritos perfect for on-the-go meals.
ingredients: 1 small red onion, halved and sliced
instructions: Place chicken and spice mix into a Ziploc bag. Shake to coat.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook chicken 5–8 minutes until golden and cooked.
Serve chicken with the rest of the ingredients. Let individuals assemble their own burritos.

title: Classic Breakfast Porridge
description: A comforting and nourishing breakfast for sustained energy.
instructions: Combine oats, cinnamon, and water in a saucepan. Heat on low, stirring 5–7 minutes.
Add remaining water and simmer for 5 more minutes.
Remove from heat. Spoon porridge into bowls.
Top with milk and fruit. Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve.

title: Pesto Smothered Pasta with Chicken
description: A protein-packed pasta dish with a fresh basil pesto.
ingredients: ½ lb fresh green beans, trimmed
instructions: Blend garlic, basil, lemon zest and juice, Parmesan, and olive oil for pesto. Set aside.
Cook pasta, then mix with pesto.
Blanch green beans. Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Cook chicken in skillet until done (5–8 mins per side).
Add tomatoes and cook 5 mins.
Serve hot with beans and pesto pasta.

title: Early Morning Frittata
description: A filling, nutritious breakfast to start your day.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Heat oil in skillet over medium. Add leek, onion, potatoes. Season and cook 5 minutes.
Add zucchini. Stir. Add eggs and ricotta. Stir to combine.
Cook 2–3 mins more. Lower heat and cook 10 more mins.
Flip onto plate and serve.

title: San Choy Bau
description: An exotic, flavorful lettuce wrap dish with pork and veggies.
instructions: Heat oils in wok. Add pork. Cook until browned.
Add ginger, garlic, mushrooms, chili, chestnuts, onion, noodles, carrot, and zucchini. Stir well.
Add lime juice, vinegar, soy sauce. Toss to combine.
Remove from heat. Add coriander. Serve in lettuce leaves topped with sesame seeds.

title: Tasty Bircher Muesli
description: A chilled oat breakfast soaked overnight for flavor and energy.
instructions: Combine milk, orange juice, water, almond meal, cinnamon, sesame, oats, and orange zest in bowl.
Cover and refrigerate 6–8 hours.
Remove, stir well, and top with blueberries.

title: Savory Curried Chicken with Beans and Currants
description: A hearty family-friendly chicken curry with green beans and raisins.
ingredients: 1½ lb chicken breast, cut into strips
13 oz green beans, trimmed and chopped
instructions: Spray skillet and cook onion over low heat until translucent.
Increase heat, add chicken and garlic. Cook until golden.
Add curry powder. Stir and cook until fragrant.
Add milk, essence, and raisins. Simmer 5 mins.
Add green beans. Simmer another 5–10 mins.
Serve over rice with coriander, cilantro, and cucumber.

title: Delicious Baked Eggs with Tomato and Spinach
description: A classy yet simple baked egg breakfast with veggies and cheese.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Grease ramekins.
Sauté tomatoes and mushrooms until browned.
Add spinach. Cook 1–2 mins. Remove from heat.
Divide mixture between ramekins. Crack eggs on top. Sprinkle with cheese and pepper.
Bake for 15 mins or until set. Serve with toast.

title: Lemon and Thyme Roasted Chicken
description: A full roast chicken meal with potatoes, carrots, and aromatics.
ingredients: 4.5 lb whole free-range chicken, rinsed and dried
½ head garlic, unpeeled and separated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Place chicken in baking dish. Stuff with thyme and tie legs.
Spray and season chicken. Arrange lemon, garlic, carrots, and potatoes around it.
Spray again. Roast 1.5 hrs or until fully cooked.
Let cool slightly before serving.

title: Early Morning Breakfast Cups
description: Quick, protein-packed egg muffins perfect for busy mornings or brunch.
ingredients: ¼ cup Parmesan cheese, freshly grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Whisk eggs and divide evenly into a muffin pan.
Distribute chopped asparagus among the cups.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until fluffy and fully cooked.
Serve immediately.

title: Tarragon Style Roasted Fish
description: A wholesome fish dinner with tarragon, lemon, lentils, and sweet potatoes.
ingredients: 2 large leeks, quartered and sliced thinly
1 lb sweet potatoes, cubed and roasted
13 oz can lentils, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Sauté leeks and garlic in oil until soft (10 mins). Set half aside.
Add lemon juice/rind, salt, pepper to remaining leeks.
Slash fish, brush with oil, stuff with leeks/lemon rounds, season again.
Wrap fish in parchment and bake for 25 mins.
Roast sweet potatoes until tender.
Mix lentils with reserved leeks, season.
Serve fish with sweet potatoes and lentils.

title: Classic French Toast
description: A comforting and healthy take on French toast using wholegrain bread.
instructions: Place milk in one bowl and eggs in another.
Spray pan with oil and heat over medium.
Dip bread in milk, then egg. Cook 2–3 mins per side until golden.
Top with ricotta, strawberries, and cinnamon.

title: Peach Style Chicken Salad
description: A refreshing and tangy summer salad with chicken, peaches, mint, and yogurt dressing.
instructions: Boil potatoes for 10 mins. Drain and set aside.
Spray pan, cook chicken 5–10 mins until done.
Add vinegar, cook until caramelized. Rest and slice.
In same pan, mix yogurt, shallots, orange zest/juice.
Toss tomatoes, cucumber, peaches, mint, and potatoes with dressing.
Add spinach and gently mix.
Serve topped with sliced chicken.

title: Hearty Bacon, Lettuce, Tomato and Egg Sandwich
description: A protein-rich breakfast sandwich that’s both satisfying and quick to prepare.
instructions: Grill bacon until cooked. Drain on paper towel.
Fry eggs and toast bread simultaneously.
Assemble sandwich with warm eggs and bacon, tomato, lettuce, and chili sauce.
Serve immediately.

title: Saffron Style Couscous Salad
description: Fragrant couscous salad with spices, veggies, and citrus. Delicious as-is or with tuna.
ingredients: 1 red onion, halved and sliced thinly
¼ tsp saffron threads, soaked in water
instructions: Cook couscous as per instructions.
Sauté onion in olive oil for 8–10 mins.
Add tomato paste, cumin, coriander, cinnamon. Cook 3–4 mins.
Add saffron and couscous. Stir well.
Add capsicum, tomatoes, olives, parsley, orange juice, lemon zest. Mix thoroughly.
Serve warm or chilled, with yogurt and wraps if desired.

title: Creamy Potato Salad
description: A light and creamy salad that’s great for picnics or as a lunch base.
instructions: Boil potatoes 10 mins or until tender. Drain and let cool.
In a bowl, mix potatoes with cucumber, yogurt, and mustard.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately.

title: Healthy Poached Chicken Salad
description: A light, protein-packed salad with beans, herbs, and lemon mustard dressing.
ingredients: 8 oz green beans, trimmed and chopped
instructions: Boil chicken stock, reduce to simmer. Add chicken and simmer 15 mins.
Shred chicken with forks.
Blanch green beans. Drain and cool.
Whisk dressing ingredients in bowl.
Combine chicken, beans, herbs, and dressing. Toss well and serve.

title: Sri Lanka Style Spicy Fish
description: A flavorful fish dish served with couscous, almonds, and fresh veggies.
instructions: Rub fish with oil and spice mix. Set aside.
Cook couscous in stock as per instructions.
Stir in parsley, lemon rind, almonds, and capsicum.
Blanch broccoli and set aside.
Grill fish 5–10 mins per side until flaky.
Serve fish over couscous with broccoli and lemon.

title: Roasted Cauliflower with Lemon and Olives
description: A low-carb, Mediterranean-inspired dish packed with flavor.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Toss cauliflower in paprika. Spread on greased tray, spray with oil.
Roast for 25 mins, turning once.
Mix cauliflower with lemon, olives, capsicum, parsley, and lemon juice.
Serve warm or room temp.

title: Tasty Fennel and Almond Salad
description: A light, sweet salad with fennel and almonds that offers a refreshing taste and healthy nutrients.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons Olive Oil, Extra Virgin Variety
1 tablespoon Dill, Fresh and Roughly Chopped
2 Fennel Bulbs, Medium, Julienne and Thinly Sliced
1 tablespoon Almonds, Slivered and Lightly Toasted
Dash of Black Pepper, For Taste
instructions: Combine lemon juice, olive oil, dill, and currants in a large bowl and mix well.
Add fennel and toss to coat evenly.
Serve over arugula and top with toasted almonds.
Season with pepper and serve immediately.

title: Nicoise Style Salad
description: A flavorful Nicoise-inspired salad packed with protein, greens, and savory vegetables.
ingredients: 13 ounces Potatoes, New Variety, Small in Size
1, 10 ounce can Tuna, In Water, Drained
½ tablespoon Olive Oil, Extra Virgin, Light
1 handful Salad Leaves, Your Favorite Variety
instructions: Boil potatoes in a saucepan with cold water for 7–8 minutes. Add green beans in the last 2 minutes.
Drain and rinse under cold water. Cut potatoes into quarters.
In a bowl, combine potatoes, beans, tomatoes, olives, capers, tuna, and mushrooms.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, and anchovies together to form dressing.
Drizzle dressing over the salad.
Top with egg quarters and serve immediately.

title: Tasty Grilled Salmon
description: A versatile grilled salmon dish topped with gremolata and served with pasta and greens.
ingredients: 2.6 ounces Spinach Leaves, Baby, Dried and Washed
2 Carrots, Large, Peeled and Cut into Small Sticks
1 bunch Parsley, Flat Leaf, Roughly Chopped
1 Clove Garlic, Crushed and Finely Chopped
instructions: Prepare gremolata: combine parsley, lemon zest/juice, garlic, olive oil, and chili. Blend and set aside.
Spray skillet and heat over medium-high. Season salmon with salt and pepper and cook 4 minutes per side.
Cook carrots and risoni according to packaging.
Serve salmon on spinach and risoni, topped with gremolata and carrots.

title: Japanese Style Coleslaw
description: A crunchy, sweet, Asian-inspired coleslaw with a miso-tahini dressing.
ingredients: ¼ Green Cabbage, Core Removed and Shaved
½ bunch Coriander, Stems Chopped, Leaves Picked
½ teaspoon Soy Sauce, Low Sodium
instructions: Combine cabbage, daikon, carrot in a large bowl.
Add shallots, coriander, sesame seeds and toss.
Whisk miso, tahini, vinegar, oil, and soy sauce with a bit of water to thin.
Pour dressing over the salad, toss well, season, and serve.

title: Cumin Spiced Carrots
description: A simple warm carrot side dish with earthy cumin and fresh lemon flavors.
ingredients: ¼ cup Parsley, Fresh, Roughly Chopped
instructions: Boil carrots until tender, then drain.
Return carrots to pan, add olive oil, parsley, and lemon juice.
Toss to coat and serve warm.

title: Crustless Spinach Quiche
description: A protein-rich egg-based dish, perfect for breakfast or brunch.
ingredients: 10oz frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
3 cups shredded cheese (Muenster, cheddar, or jack)
instructions: In a large skillet, cook onions in coconut oil or butter until soft.
Stir in spinach and allow excess moisture to evaporate.
In a large bowl, mix eggs, cheese, salt, and pepper.
Add spinach-onion mixture and stir to combine.
Pour into a buttered 9-inch pie dish.
Bake in a 350°F oven for about 30 minutes until eggs set.
Let cool for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Grain-free Granola
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 1/4 cup coconut oil or butter, melted
1 cup chopped walnuts, pecans, hazelnuts, or macadamia nuts
instructions: Melt coconut oil or butter and mix with remaining ingredients.
Spread onto a large baking sheet.
Bake at 275°F for 25 minutes until golden brown and fragrant.
Cool and store in airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 month.

title: Beanless Beef Chili
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Soak chipotle pepper in boiling water until softened, then mince.
Sauté onions and peppers in coconut oil until tender.
Add garlic and chipotle; cook until fragrant.
Add beef and sausage; brown and crumble.
Stir in spices, cocoa, Worcestershire, and tomatoes.
Simmer for 10 minutes to develop flavor.

title: Salmon Salad
description: A fresh and healthy salad option, great for any meal.
ingredients: 16 oz wild Alaskan salmon, cooked, skin and bones removed
instructions: Place salmon in bowl, flake with fork.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix gently to combine and serve cold or room temperature.

title: Roasted Curried Cauliflower
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower (2 lbs), cut into florets
1–2 inch ginger, grated OR 1 tsp ground ginger
2 garlic cloves, minced OR 1 tsp garlic powder
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar or pomegranate molasses
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Toss vegetables and spices in large baking pan.
Add coconut milk, oil/ghee, and vinegar.
Roast for 30–40 minutes until browned and tender.
Serve hot or cold.

title: Grass-fed Beef Meatloaf
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 1/4 cup almond meal or coconut flour
instructions: Sauté onion, mushrooms, garlic in oil; let cool.
Mix all meatloaf ingredients.
Form loaf in 9x13 dish.
Mix topping and spread on loaf.
Bake at 350°F for 45–60 minutes until cooked through.

title: Roasted Carrots, Celery, and Onions
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Mix all ingredients on a large baking pan.
Bake for 30–45 minutes, turning occasionally, until lightly browned and fork tender.

title: Homemade Chicken Vegetable Soup
description: A warm and hearty dish, ideal for cozy meals.
ingredients: 1 lb cooked chicken meat (shredded or chopped)
instructions: Sauté vegetables in butter with salt, pepper, and thyme until browned.
Add chicken stock and bring to a boil.
Add chicken meat, cream, and lemon juice. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Adjust seasoning and garnish with parsley.

title: Homemade Chicken Stock
description: A flavorful chicken dish, full of protein and great for lunch or dinner.
ingredients: 1 whole chicken or 2–3 lbs bony parts
instructions: Place all ingredients in a slow cooker or pot. Cover with water.
Simmer on low for at least 24 hours.
Skim foam, strain, and store in fridge for up to 3 days or freeze.

title: Slow Cooker Carnitas
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: Juice of 2 limes (or 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar)
instructions: Place onions in bottom of slow cooker.
Rub pork with spices and place in cooker. Add lime juice.
Cook on high 6–8 hours until fork tender.
Shred and crisp in a skillet if desired.

title: Tomato-Cream Sauce
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Heat butter and oil, sauté onion, salt, pepper, oregano for 5 minutes.
Add garlic, cook 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes and simmer 25–30 minutes.
Stir in cream and basil. Serve over spaghetti squash or other veggies.

title: Grass-fed Beef Meatballs
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Sauté onion, mushrooms, garlic in oil until browned. Let cool.
Mix with beef, liver, egg, and spices. Form 12 meatballs.
Bake at 350°F for 15–20 minutes until cooked through.

title: Low-carb Shepherd’s Pie
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Steam cauliflower until soft, about 10–15 minutes.
In skillet, brown ground beef, then add liver (if using) and cook for 1–2 minutes.
Transfer meat to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In same skillet, sauté onion, carrot, celery, garlic, and seasonings in butter for 10 minutes.
Spread cooked vegetables over meat.
Mash cauliflower with butter, salt, and pepper. Spread over vegetables.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Coconut Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful chicken dish, full of protein and great for lunch or dinner.
ingredients: 1 cup green beans, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces
2 tablespoons mild curry powder (e.g., garam masala)
Dash of soy sauce or tamari (to taste)
Chili flakes or fresh chili slices (optional)
instructions: Sauté onion in coconut oil over medium-high heat until browned.
Add remaining vegetables, garlic, ginger, curry powder, and salt. Cook 5 minutes.
Add coconut milk, broth, and chicken. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add lime juice and soy sauce. Stir in spinach just before serving to wilt.

title: Homemade Berry Sorbet
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 1 cup frozen berries (blueberries, raspberries, or blackberries)
1 packet stevia sweetener or 5–10 drops stevia extract (optional)
instructions: Puree all ingredients using a blender, immersion blender, or food processor.
Serve immediately.

title: Coconut Macaroons
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vanilla extract or almond extract
instructions: Whisk egg whites and salt until stiff.
Fold in honey, extract, and coconut.
Scoop 1 tbsp portions onto parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake at 350°F for 10–15 minutes until golden.

title: Nutty 'Granola' Bars
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 4 tablespoons ground flaxseeds or chia seeds
1 cup raw walnut pieces (or other nuts)
instructions: Mix flax/chia with honey and egg in small bowl.
Mix remaining ingredients in large bowl.
Combine both mixtures. Press into parchment-lined sheet tray.
Cover with another parchment sheet and press firmly with flat object.
Remove top sheet and bake at 350°F for 24 minutes, rotating at 12 minutes.
Cool completely and cut into 24 bars.

title: Nutty 'Granola' Bars
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 4 tablespoons ground flaxseeds or chia seeds
1 cup raw walnut pieces (or other nuts)
instructions: Mix flax/chia with honey and egg in a small bowl.
In a large bowl, combine remaining ingredients.
Add honey mixture to nut mixture and stir well.
Line a sheet tray with parchment paper. Spread the mix evenly on tray.
Cover with another parchment sheet and press firmly (use pot bottom or flat surface).
Remove top sheet, bake at 350°F for 24 minutes, rotating halfway through.
Cool completely and cut into 24 bars.

title: Slow Cooker Carnitas
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: Juice of 2 limes or 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar
instructions: Place sliced onion at the bottom of the slow cooker.
Rub pork shoulder with spices and salt. Place into slow cooker.
Add lime juice or vinegar.
Cook on high for 6–8 hours, or until pork easily shreds with a fork.
Remove pork and shred. Optional: crisp in a skillet with rendered fat for texture.
Serve hot.

title: Tomato-Cream Sauce (for Spaghetti Squash)
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Heat butter and oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add onion, salt, pepper, and oregano. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 2 more minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes and reduce heat to low. Simmer 25–30 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in cream. Adjust seasoning.
Add basil. Serve over cooked spaghetti squash.

title: Greenie Green Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
ingredients: 20 moscato grapes or chilled green grapes
1 tablespoon agave nectar or 1 teaspoon stevia
instructions: Remove cores from apple and pear.
Add water and a few chunks of apple/pear to blender and blend until liquid.
Gradually add remaining fruit chunks, blending each time.
Add mint and kale in batches, blending completely.
Add grapes, lime juice, cinnamon, sweetener, and ice. Blend until smooth.
Serve chilled.

title: Chia Seed Coconut & Spinach Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
instructions: Add all ingredients to blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Serve immediately.

title: Breakfast Oatmeal Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
instructions: Blend all ingredients together until smooth and creamy.
Serve immediately.

title: Delicious Berry Delight
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Add all ingredients (except sweetener) to blender and blend until smooth.
Taste and stir in sweetener if needed.
Serve immediately with optional berry topping.

title: Strawberry Shake
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: ⅓ cup sugar-free vanilla frozen yogurt
instructions: Blend yogurt, milk, and ice for 1-2 minutes.
Add strawberries and extract, blend 30 seconds.
Serve immediately.

title: Cherry Yogurt Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
ingredients: 1 cup dark sweet cherries, thawed, pitted, and quartered
instructions: Line strainer with coffee filter and drain yogurt overnight.
Transfer strained yogurt to bowl.
Stir in remaining ingredients and chill until ready to serve.

title: Pumpkin Cream Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
ingredients: Optional: Blackstrap molasses, ½–1 scoop protein powder
instructions: Add milk and ice to blender.
Add pumpkin puree, sweetener, spice, and optional ingredients.
Blend until smooth.
Add nuts and coconut cream, blend a few seconds more.
Serve chilled.

title: Mango Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
ingredients: 2 containers (6 oz each) low-fat vanilla yogurt
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Pour into glasses, garnish with mango chunks.
Serve.

title: Pineapple Kale Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Serve immediately.

title: Orange Mango Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Serve immediately.

title: Greenie Green Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
ingredients: 1 green apple, ripe, cut into small chunks
1 green pear, ripe, cut into small chunks
½ cup fresh mint, roughly chopped
20 moscato grapes or chilled green grapes
1 tablespoon agave nectar or 1 teaspoon stevia (to taste)
instructions: Remove the core from the apple and pear.
Fill the bottom of your blender with water and add a small handful of pear and apple chunks. Blend until fully liquid.
Gradually add the remaining pear and apple chunks while blending.
Slowly add mint and kale, blending until fully incorporated.
Add grapes, lime juice, cinnamon, stevia or agave, and ice. Blend until smooth.
Serve chilled.

title: Chia Seed Coconut & Spinach Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend on high until smooth and creamy.
Serve immediately.

title: Breakfast Oatmeal Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
ingredients: 2 frozen bananas, cut into small chunks
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend on high until smooth and creamy.
Serve immediately.

title: Delicious Berry Delight
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Add all ingredients (except sweetener) to a blender.
Blend on high until smooth and creamy.
Add sweetener if desired and stir well.
Serve topped with fresh raspberries or blackberries.

title: Strawberry Shake
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: ⅓ cup sugar-free vanilla yogurt, frozen and low-fat
instructions: Blend yogurt, milk, and crushed ice for 1–2 minutes.
Add strawberries and extract.
Blend again until strawberries are finely chopped.
Serve in a large glass.

title: Cherry Yogurt Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons pure honey or sugar-free sweetener, to taste
1 cup dark sweet cherries, frozen, thawed, pitted & quartered
instructions: Line a strainer with a coffee filter or cheesecloth and place over a large bowl.
Add yogurt to strainer, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
Discard drained liquid and transfer thickened yogurt to a mixing bowl.
Stir in cherries, vanilla, cherry juice, and sweetener.
Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Pumpkin Cream Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
ingredients: Optional: blackstrap molasses, ½ to 1 scoop protein powder (whey or dairy-free)
instructions: Fill a smoothie cup with almond milk and ice cubes.
Add pumpkin puree, pumpkin pie spice, stevia, and any optional ingredients.
Blend until ice is crushed and mixture is smooth.
Add coconut cream and optional nuts, blend again briefly.
Serve chilled.

title: Mango Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
ingredients: 2 cups frozen mango chunks (plus more for garnish)
2 containers low-fat vanilla yogurt (6 oz each)
instructions: Add mango, orange juice, lime juice, yogurt, vanilla, and salt to blender.
Blend until smooth.
Divide into glasses and garnish with mango chunks.
Serve chilled.

title: Pineapple Kale Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
instructions: Add all ingredients to blender.
Blend for 1–2 minutes until smooth and silky.
Serve immediately.

title: Orange Mango Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth (1–2 minutes).
Serve immediately. Garnish with orange wedges or mango chunks if desired.

title: Guacamole-Stuffed Eggs
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: ¼ cup tomato salsa, freshly prepared
Cracked black pepper & kosher salt to taste
instructions: Place eggs in a saucepan in a single layer. Cover with water and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat and cook for 8–10 minutes.
Remove eggs and place in ice-cold water until cool enough to handle. Peel and chill.
Mash avocado with lemon juice and salsa until chunky.
Slice eggs lengthwise, discard yolks, and fill each half with about 2 tsp guacamole.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper before serving.

title: Cherry, Wild Rice & Quinoa Salad
description: A fresh and healthy salad option, great for any meal.
ingredients: ¾ cup aged goat cheese, diced & smoked
¼ cup fruity vinegar (pomegranate or raspberry)
2 cups fresh sweet cherries, halved & pitted
instructions: Boil wild rice for 30 minutes. Add quinoa and cook for 15 more minutes. Drain well.
Whisk vinegar, olive oil, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add cooked grains, celery, cherries, pecans, and goat cheese. Toss gently.
Serve immediately.

title: Chicken and Broccoli
description: A flavorful chicken dish, full of protein and great for lunch or dinner.
ingredients: 2 tbsp grated Parmesan cheese plus extra
instructions: Steam chicken until tender. Reserve 2 cups of liquid. Remove bones and cut meat.
Boil broccoli 12–15 mins, drain.
Make roux with butter and flour. Slowly add reserved liquid, cook until thick.
Add sherry and cream. Layer broccoli in a dish, pour half sauce, add chicken, then remaining sauce.
Sprinkle with extra Parmesan. Broil until bubbling and golden.

title: Chicken Veggie Stir Fry
description: A flavorful chicken dish, full of protein and great for lunch or dinner.
instructions: Marinate chicken in soy sauce, sesame oil, lime juice, and ginger for 2 hours.
Heat oil in a wok and stir fry chicken with marinade.
Add vegetables and stir fry until tender, about 7 minutes.
Add remaining lime juice, sesame oil, soy sauce, basil, and cilantro.
Serve hot with optional brown rice.

title: Delicious Chargrilled Fish
description: A light and healthy seafood dish, rich in omega-3s.
instructions: Sauté onion, ginger, and mustard seeds in oil. Add coconut and cook until golden.
Remove from heat and add sugar, tomato, coriander, chili, and lime juice.
Grill fish on chargrill 2–3 mins per side until golden and flaky.
Serve fish topped with coconut mixture.

title: Avocado Chicken Salad
description: A fresh and healthy salad option, great for any meal.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well.
Serve immediately and enjoy.

title: Fried Brown Rice
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: ½ cup frozen peas and carrots, thawed
instructions: Heat margarine in nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Add egg substitute and stir-fry until just set.
Stir in onion, rice, peas, carrots, and broth.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer a few minutes.
Remove from heat, stir, let stand covered. Fluff before serving.

title: Salmon Salad
description: A fresh and healthy salad option, great for any meal.
ingredients: ½ cup canned salmon, skinless and boneless
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well.
Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 2 days.

title: Delicious Sandwich
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: ¼ medium red bell pepper, sliced
instructions: Spread hummus on one slice of bread, avocado on the other.
Layer with carrot, greens, cucumber, and bell pepper.
Assemble sandwich, slice, and serve.

title: Zucchini Noodles with Quick Turkey Bolognese
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Divide zucchini noodles into containers.
Top with ¾ cup turkey sauce and 2 tbsp Parmesan per container.
Refrigerate until ready to serve. Microwave 2–3 minutes to warm.

title: Lentil Soup
description: A warm and hearty dish, ideal for cozy meals.
ingredients: 1 cup brown or French green lentils
instructions: Sauté onions in oil, season with salt, and caramelize.
Boil lentils in 4 cups water for 20 minutes.
Add chard ribs, scallions, broth, potato, and salt. Simmer 15 mins.
Add broccoli, chard leaves, coriander, cumin. Add caramelized onions.
Stir in spinach, mint, cilantro, pepper, jalapeño. Simmer 5 mins.
Finish with lemon juice and serve with olive oil & feta (optional).

title: Delicious Chicken with Parmesan-Herb Sauce
description: A flavorful chicken dish, full of protein and great for lunch or dinner.
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts (12 oz each), skinless, bone-in, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Dredge chicken in flour with salt & pepper.
Sear chicken in skillet with 2 tbsp oil. Transfer to baking sheet.
Toss broccoli with garlic, 2 tbsp oil, salt. Bake with chicken 20 mins.
Whisk wine and remaining flour. Cook remaining garlic, add broth.
Add wine mix and simmer until thick. Stir in Parmesan and thyme.
Serve chicken and broccoli over rice, spoon sauce on top.

title: Slow Cooker Beef Stew
description: A warm and hearty dish, ideal for cozy meals.
instructions: Brown beef in butter or oil. Transfer to slow cooker with veggies and herbs.
Dissolve OXO in water. Pour into cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 6–8 hours.
Remove bay leaves. Serve hot.

title: Chilli Con Carne
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Sauté onions, then brown beef.
Add garlic, peppers, chilies, and spices.
Add tomatoes, stock, purée. Simmer 15 mins.
Add drained beans and heat through.
Serve hot with rice or wrap.

title: Spanish Frittata
description: A protein-rich egg-based dish, perfect for breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Slice potatoes. Sauté onion until soft.
Beat eggs, then add potatoes, onion, ham, parsley, salt, pepper.
Pour into pan and cook gently. Sprinkle with cheese.
Grill top until golden. Serve warm.

title: Pumpkin Cream Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
ingredients: Stevia extract, to taste, preferably 3 to 4 shakes
Optional: ½ to 1 scoop whey or dairy-free protein powder
instructions: Fill a smoothie cup with milk and add ice cubes.
Add pumpkin puree, stevia, pumpkin pie spice, and optional ingredients.
Blend until smooth and ice is crushed.
Add nuts and coconut cream, blend again.
Serve chilled.

title: Mango Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
ingredients: 2 cups mango chunks, frozen (plus more for garnish)
2 containers vanilla yogurt (6 oz each), low-fat
instructions: Blend mango, orange juice, lime juice, vanilla, yogurt, and salt until smooth.
Pour into glasses, garnish with mango chunks, and enjoy.

title: Pineapple Kale Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth and silky.
Serve immediately.

title: Orange Mango Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Serve immediately.

title: Low Sugar Berry Smoothie
description: A refreshing and nutritious drink, perfect for a quick energy boost.
instructions: Blend all ingredients until completely smooth and creamy.
Serve immediately.

title: Old-Fashioned Oatmeal
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat milk plus 1 fl oz for serving
instructions: Heat milk and salt in saucepan, bring to boil.
Stir in oats, reduce heat, cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat, let stand covered 2 minutes.
Top with honey, milk, cinnamon, nuts or dried fruit.

title: Bagel Avocado Toast
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Spread mashed avocado on toast.
Top with bagel seasoning and salt.
Serve immediately.

title: Spinach & Egg Sweet Potato Toast
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Toast sweet potato slice for 12–15 minutes.
Top with cooked spinach, egg, hot sauce, and chives.
Serve immediately.

title: Mushroom and Tomato Omelet
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Beat eggs and egg whites in bowl.
Heat non-stick pan, cook eggs.
Add mushrooms, tomatoes, and cheese in center, fold and cook until set.
Serve warm.

title: Cauliflower Crust Quiche
description: A protein-rich egg-based dish, perfect for breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F with baking sheet inside.
Cook cauliflower in simmering water 6–8 min, drain well.
Mix 2 egg whites with cauliflower, Parmesan, cumin, and salt. Press into greased pie pan.
Bake crust 7–10 min until light golden. Reduce oven to 350°F.
Add onions, spinach, artichokes, and mushrooms on top of crust.
Whisk remaining eggs, garlic, and almond milk. Pour over vegetables.
Bake 35–40 min. Sprinkle with feta and serve after cooling slightly.

title: Crustless Quiche
description: A protein-rich egg-based dish, perfect for breakfast or brunch.
ingredients: ½ pound fillings, cooked (e.g., ham, bacon, vegetables)
Ground black pepper & salt, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a baking dish with butter.
Cook onion in oil until soft; place in the baking dish.
Add cooked fillings to dish.
Whisk eggs, cream, salt, and pepper. Pour into dish.
Top with grated cheese and any extra toppings.
Bake for 25–30 minutes until set and golden. Do not overcook.

title: Delicious Chicken, Mushrooms & Brussels Sprouts Pasta
description: A flavorful chicken dish, full of protein and great for lunch or dinner.
ingredients: 1 lb chicken thighs, boneless and skinless
instructions: Combine chicken, pasta, vegetables, cheese, and seasonings in a large pot.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Cook for 10–12 minutes, stirring frequently, until pasta is cooked and water is mostly absorbed.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Top with fresh chives before serving.

title: Slow Cooker Beef Stew
description: A warm and hearty dish, ideal for cozy meals.
ingredients: 1 tsp each: dried parsley, thyme, rosemary
instructions: Brown beef in butter over medium heat; transfer to slow cooker.
Add chopped vegetables, stock pot, herbs.
Dissolve OXO cube in water and pour over ingredients.
Cover and cook on low for 6–8 hours.
Remove bay leaves before serving.

title: Chilli Con Carne
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Sauté onions in oil until soft. Add beef and brown.
Add garlic, peppers, chilies, and spices. Stir well.
Add tomatoes, stock, and tomato purée. Bring to boil.
Simmer 12–15 minutes until thickened.
Add drained beans and heat through. Serve hot.

title: Spanish Frittata
description: A protein-rich egg-based dish, perfect for breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Sauté onions in olive oil until soft.
Beat eggs and mix with onions, ham, potatoes, parsley, salt and pepper.
Pour into pan, cook for a few minutes.
Sprinkle cheese on top and grill until golden.
Serve warm.

title: Sweet Potato Dauphinoise
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 50 g Gruyère or cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and grease ramekins with butter.
Layer sweet potato slices inside ramekins.
Warm cream with garlic, rosemary, salt, pepper. Do not boil.
Pour cream over sweet potato. Top with cheese.
Cover with foil and bake for 17–20 minutes.
Uncover and bake 10 more minutes until crispy.

title: Crispy Garlic Parmesan Wings
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: ½ oz parmesan cheese, grated (about ½ cup)
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°F. Line tray with foil and set rack on top.
Pat wings dry, coat with baking powder, salt, pepper.
Bake for 30 mins on lower rack. Raise oven to 425°F.
Bake 20–30 more mins until crispy.
Toss wings with butter, garlic, pepper flakes, and parmesan.
Top with fresh herbs and serve hot.

title: Lemon Pepper Chicken
description: A flavorful chicken dish, full of protein and great for lunch or dinner.
ingredients: ½ tsp each: onion powder, Italian seasoning, paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line baking sheet with foil.
Mix lemon juice and oil. Rub over chicken.
Mix dry spices and season chicken evenly.
Bake for 35–45 minutes until cooked through.
Serve warm with optional lemon/lime wedges.

title: Baked Chicken Wings
description: A flavorful chicken dish, full of protein and great for lunch or dinner.
ingredients: 2 tsp each: onion powder, garlic powder, dried parsley, sea salt
instructions: Marinate wings in oil and vinegar in fridge for 1–2 hours.
Preheat oven to 425°F and bake wings for 30 minutes.
Mix dry seasonings in bowl.
Remove wings, coat with seasoning.
Broil 3–5 mins until golden.
Drizzle with malt vinegar and serve hot.

title: Creamy Cauliflower Cheese
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: Paprika, white pepper & salt, to taste
instructions: Boil or steam cauliflower until just tender, then drain.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Melt butter, add cream and most of cheese, stir to melt.
Add mustard, paprika, pepper, salt.
Place cauliflower in dish, pour sauce over top, add more cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbly.

Blend on high until smooth and creamy.
Serve immediately. Thin with more water if desired.

A pinch each of cinnamon and salt
instructions: Heat milk and salt in a saucepan over moderate heat until boiling.
Stir in oats, reduce heat to medium, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat, cover, and let stand for 2 minutes.
Top with honey, extra milk, cinnamon, and optional nuts or dried fruits.

title: Bagel Avocado Toast
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Spread mashed avocado over the toasted bread.
Top with bagel seasoning and sea salt.
Serve immediately and enjoy.

description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 1 slice large sweet potato (about ¼" thick)
instructions: Toast sweet potato slice in toaster or toaster oven for 12–15 minutes until just cooked through.
Top with spinach, egg, hot sauce, and chives.
Serve warm.

title: Mushroom and Tomato Omelet
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Beat eggs in a bowl.
Spray non-stick pan with cooking spray and cook eggs over medium heat.
Add cottage cheese, mushrooms, and tomato to the center.
Fold over and cook until set.
Serve warm.

title: Cauliflower Crust Quiche
description: A protein-rich egg-based dish, perfect for breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Steam cauliflower, drain well.
Mix 2 egg whites with cauliflower, parmesan, cumin, and salt. Press into greased pie pan and bake 7–10 mins.
Reduce oven to 350°F. Layer spinach, mushrooms, onions, and artichokes in crust.
Whisk remaining eggs, yolks, garlic, and almond milk. Pour into crust.
Bake 35–40 minutes until set. Top with feta and cool slightly before serving.

title: Veggie Tofu Scramble
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
instructions: Sauté bell pepper and mushrooms in oil until soft, then set aside.
Cook tofu in lightly greased pan over medium heat until firm.
Add cooked vegetables to center, fold over, and cook a few more minutes.
Serve warm.

title: Sweet Potato, Chard & Turkey Sausage Hash with Eggs
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: 4 stalks scallions (white and green parts separated)
⅛ teaspoon Mediterranean coarse sea salt
instructions: Sauté sweet potato, scallion whites, vinegar, and ¼ tsp salt in oil, covered, 8–10 mins.
Add sausage and cook 2–3 mins more.
Uncover and caramelize 3–5 mins. Add chard, scallion greens, rosemary, vinegar, and salt. Sauté until wilted.
Poach eggs in simmering water until whites are opaque.
Plate hash, top with eggs, sprinkle remaining salt, and serve.

title: Guacamole-Stuffed Eggs
description: A gestational diabetes-friendly dish suitable for balanced meals.
ingredients: Salt and cracked black pepper to taste
instructions: Boil eggs for 8–10 minutes. Cool in ice water and peel.
Mash avocado with salsa and lemon juice until slightly chunky.

Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Garnish with cilantro if desired.
